data.body: Pre-implementation audit (2026-08-21): a1 (freq_mult amplify-only + SERIOUS never dampened) was SUBSUMED by code-v4, which landed on main 2026-08-20 as commit 61d50b0513 (ticket 7f9f-05f4-796a-4c63) — the debt-lane churn amplifier is [1.0,1.5] and the serious-maint lane is undamped, already pinned by tests/unit/test_impact_code.py. This ticket therefore implements a2 + proposal-3 on top of code-v4 and only corrects the stale 'churn 0 => freq_mult 0.5' comment in workflow_ops.py for a1. Interpretation decision recorded in the description: the boost keys detection on the EXPORT per the user-approved design comment ('NOT on a cited caller'); the operator scope comment's 'together with a named broken caller' phrase describes the citric finding, not a detection requirement. IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION will bump code-v4 -> code-v5.
